description: Sampler that plays SFZ instruments, polyphonic, with velocity, exponential pitch modulation and through-zero linear FM using the samples as the carrier; an instrument is loaded from the context menu

params.text: Tunes the player over a two octave range
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the FM jack before it is added to the pitch knob
Sets the depth of the through-zero linear FM from the signal at the LFM jack
Transposes the player in octaves over a ten octave range

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of each voice, a volt per octave with 0V as C4; the number of channels on this cable sets how many voices play
Sets the velocity of each note, 0V for MIDI velocity zero and 10V for velocity 127; what an instrument does with velocity varies, often picking between samples or setting the level
Starts a note while the voltage is above 1V and ends it below that, one channel per voice
Bends the pitch exponentially through the trim knob above it, positive voltage raising the pitch and negative lowering it
The modulator for through-zero linear FM, with the samples as the carrier; an audio rate signal is the usual thing to patch here
Scales the depth of the linear FM, 0V for none and 10V for the full depth set by the Depth knob; with nothing patched it acts as though 10V were present

outputs.text: The instrument's audio, polyphonic with one channel per voice

notes: the module is silent until an SFZ instrument is loaded from Load SFZ file on its right-click menu; nothing is shipped with the plugin, so the file has to be downloaded first
both the V/Oct and the Gate inputs have to be patched before a note plays
the trim knob above the FM jack comes up at zero, so a cable there changes nothing until the trim is turned off centre
menu: Load SFZ file — opens a file picker for the instrument; the display at the top then shows its name and the range of pitches it answers to, or the error if it would not load
Trigger delay — holds the gate input back by 5 samples, which is on when the module is added and worth leaving on in most patches
